comments: Great proffesor, and a simple class as long as you participate. I learned a lot in this class through Timo's personal stories being in different businesses.

I really enjoyed this class this semester. He is very passionate about teaching and cares about his students and wants them to succeed. This class is very interactive and it made it a lot more enjoyable to attend. I recommend taking this class.
Professor Timo is one of the best professor that I have taken at UT. His lectures were engaging and interesting. Definitely take him if you can!

It's difficult to find a professor who cares nowadays and Mr. Zalatimo really tried. He may be from another country but he brought only the good parts to this class. I thank him for making this class entertaining by participating with us and for trying to adapt to his students. We should give more credit to real professors like Ammar Zalatimo.
Goat
Would recommend taking this professor. He wants your to learn and makes the class engaging and interactive. Very nice and caring person and not a very intensive or hard class overall.
Overall, Great professor! He gets what he needs to get done and doesnt waste time. I would take his class again and recommend taking him if you have to take MKT300.
Makes class interesting and engaging. Actually cares about students success. Highly recommend.
Great professor very professional.
Timo is a great professor! He loves his students and is very passionate about what he is teaching. 100% recommend him!
New professor but is pretty awesome. Cares about his students and wants you to do well.
great professor! Made everything seem simple.
Amazing professor that cares for his students. Lectures are interesting and engaging. Would definitely take again
I would definitely take this professor again, so good!! He was amazing very caring and helpful and wants the best for his students. I loved him!!!
He is a funny professor who cares about his students. He makes the class enjoyable with his custom slides and engaging class. You have to participate but he makes it easy to do so.
The boy
He's an easy to follow teacher
Chiller

Best professor I have ever had at any school I have gone to. He engages with the students and let everyone talk. He also doesn't mind if you disagree or speak up if there is something that you want to say. He wants his students to tell him if there is anything we don't like about his teaching style so he can get better. Truly recommended!
Timo is very passionate about what he teaches and constantly asks his students for feedback on how to improve his lecture. The assignments are pretty easy and straightforward

Terrible professor. Dont get me wrong, very intelligent and knows his stuff. But he could care less about his students. Made me and other students cry during our one-on-one final and then went on to tell us we did not try, even though hours were spent preparing. The earlier reviews speak nicely of him so maybe he is just a very spiteful person now

It is not a question of his intellectual skills but, his ability to teach a class. For one, his hand writing is horrendous. Participation is mandatory. He feels generous and gives 2 "unexcused abcenses" but these are not actually a "free miss class". You will still get points deducted! Just don't.

Oh god he is the meanest man you will ever meet. If you do not live up to his standards, of French you are doomed from the get go, his exams are never given with enough prep time, and he does not care about his students at all. Safe yourself from this horrible experience.

Don't buy the access code for the textbook! You don't use it. I liked Memon a lot- he really tried to get people speaking in class and actually using and practicing the grammar we were learning. He might give you a jokey hard time, but don't take it personally. He's just trying to get you to speak more in French like real people do.

Anis made my Italian 1 class a laugh riot. If you demonstrate any level of interest in learning the language, he is very helpful and understanding. He focuses his class on learning to speak rather than hard and fast grammar, which is good if your learning as a non-major. It was a ton of fun, and very informative.

Wonderful professor, but very difficult grading. Be sure to participate in foreign small-talk at the start of every class and it will really help your participation grade. Mine went from a 65 to a 95 when I started talking. Tests are tough, but you can make up for them by coming out of your comfort zone and talking in class. He's a really nice guy.

He is not understanding of students lives or needs, and if he can't give you a bad grade because you're good at italian, he will give you a bad participation grade that counts for most of your overall grade. DO NOT take this class, he is a horrible teacher.

Anis was rude to me and made me feel alienated from the class. I didn't really like him or his teaching style, which is a lot sarcasm and jokes that might fly over your head if you aren't that advanced in french. Kind of creates a hierarchy of students in the class. Heard he was a creep towards girls in his classes, always talked about Rasputins

He's a great guy, really funny. You have to commit yourself to learning the language to really excel, but if you're just trying to fulfill a requirement he's cool with that as well. Awesome dude, definitely recommend.
Love Anis. He's so helpful, animated, and funny. One of the best professors i've encountered

Rigorous but the best class. If you get a chance to take 107 with Memon do it. Class is interesting and challenging and you will improve your French. Plus he's a great prof. Creative and humorous. He keeps things relevant and yet challenges the student to think in French.
Smart guy, very helpful. Classes are always upbeat and fun to participate in. Great class
This guy is the man. Good sense of humor, accessible, and a great teacher.

2011: Anis is very knowledgeable with grammar & languages.  He presents an interactive class. Expectations are high - do not be unprepared. There are regular daily quizzes & hw. Can be rough to manage with other high demanding courses (esp 4 credits). However, he has a sense of humor & can be entertained - despite appearances! Merci bien, Memon!

TESTS ARE HARD but not impossible. Anis is very upbeat and LOVES French grammar. Study for his tests, stay on top of things and you'll be fine. He includes some lit stuff so be prepared. If you get a poem to discuss in class, review it for the test. If you want to improve your French, he's the man.

Anis is a wonderful teacher. He is extremely energetic, hilarious and very passionate about French. He's very helpful and clear about what he wants. Quizzes are very fair. Homework and participation are a must if you want to keep up and get a good grade. Overall amazing teacher and I highly recommend any of his classes!

His classes are generally amusing but he's kind of a prick. Sometimes will pick on people when at least they are trying to participate. Is a little pompous about his French skills and gives a LOT of homework, some of it very difficult. His quizzes are short and not too difficult but make sure you study because I rarely got an A on them. An ok class

He's a great teacher who really works hard to engage his student. Participation is key if you want to get something concrete out of his classes. Probably one of the funniest teachers I've ever had once you can understand his french humor.

Anis is great! I took three years of french in high school but now I think i might retain something after taking his class. The emersion is great, and he makes his class so comfortable and fun! Great guy.
Anis is the most energetic teacher I've had. He always smiles and puts a lot of energy into his work. Show up to class, participate a lot and you will get an A. His quizzes are also very easy.

Abedi is one of the funniest professors you will have in engineering. His sense of humor adds to the class and he does a good job building intuition into lectures. He has a big emphasis on participation which makes the class very engaging so don't skip! He will know if you do, and will call you out. Thermo seems daunting but Abedi makes it easy.

Literally the funniest man ever. Loved his dry humor, but also he would drone on in lectures. Very hard to pay attention to. He speaks with a lot of long pauses in btwn sentences and is not super clear when doing practice problems. Hard to follow, accent made it a little bit harder as well. But he cares how students do and wants them to succeed.

Do not take this professor if you want to learn. Did not learn a single thing during his lectures, he was consistently late, and always spends half the class on random rants. He never responds to your emails and never posts anything on canvas.
Abedi is a great professor who understands the content well and knows how to convey it clearly to his students. While the content is challenging and exams are difficult the course is manageable.
Mehdi is tough, but he cares! Took 3 classes with him that had a serious impact on my career.
He has a massive ego and hates his students.
Bro is a whole villain

Thermo can be a difficult class, especially given its huge amount of homework (several hours of homework 3 TIMES A WEEK). I really did enjoy Abedi's lectures though and once you get over his dry humor, it can be a really fun class to go to.

Be prepared to learn on your own, because his lectures are poor and he is very mean to students that ask questions. In class he even said that "it is not his responsibility" to go over everything and that you need to learn on your own. He also wastes an incredible amount of time on rants, despite the fact that this course covers many topics.

Abedi was a tough but fair professor and you get out what you put in. If you do the homework, pay attention in class, and ask questions, the class is straightforward. The exams are straightforward as well and follow the concepts in the homeworks.

Horrendously unorganized. Incredibly difficult to following what he was communicating in lectures due to his horrible handwriting and his refusal to show or share any sort of slide deck. He did not tell us when tests were less than a week before they happened and they were outside of class time, so I couldn't coordinate my work schedule properly.

Absolutely the worst teacher I have ever had in anything. It was bad enough that he was incompetent at teaching the subject, but when I started having mental health issues in his class and asked him for help, he didn't seem to care at all. People like this should not be teachers.

Make no mistake, Mehdi makes you work for a decent grade, but much like everyone else says, he really does care that you learn more over all else. His lectures are definitely worth it, since there is daily homework in the class. And if you want to do well, you must read the textbook consistently. But overall, a solid professor.
The best professor I have ever had. He is all about making sure you LEARN not pass. He gives out good grades to those who put in the effort to learn how to be good engineers.

I took statics with him and he taught us the material after we had homework due on it. We had to read the textbook to figure it out and use the internet which renders him useless except for somewhat reinforcing concepts.

Thermodynamics with Prof. Abedi is by far the hardest class I've ever taken, but I can guarantee it's better than taking this class taught by any other professor. He will make you work VERY hard and you really have to read the textbook to succeed, but he will really make sure your understand the material.
He will come off maybe rude and tough but at the end of the day he is all about LEARNING. He wants you to learn and be a better engineer. One of the best teachers Ive had!

Mehdi is an amazing professor. He initially comes across as very tough, strict and cold, but quickly shows how good he as at teaching. Can be very entertaining in class and is very clear with his lectures and what he expects of you. Reading before class or at all is super important since it can help a lot with in class work, homework and tests.

He's probably one of the most well known professors in the MECHE department. He WILL intimidate everyone, but you will definitely know the material by the end of the course. He's also hilarious and a genuinely nice, caring guy. If you need an easy class avoid him, if you want to know the material better than the other sections, take him.

What a guy. Put the work in. He's very available at office hours. Tests are meant to make you think - tend to be open book open notes so they won't be the same as the homework. You need to be doing the hw.
Summer 1 only graded by 2 papers and a midterm (short essays). Interesting material and insight from the professor but its all provided reading. (rating keep in mind im a bad essay writer)
Margot is a very sweet professor but her lecture style wasn't for me. The prompts for papers were vague and unclear, making this intro-level class more difficult.
Really good prof who cares about the students. Grades harshly so you have to work for a good grade and participate.

Margot is super caring and always created a very comfortable class environment. Assigns lots of readings and most of the class is discussion-based. Margot is super flexible if you are uncomfortable talking in discussions. Lets students meet with her to discuss assignments and think of other ways to increase a participation grade.

Professor Abels is a very caring and interesting professor. Her class leaned a little too far into discussion for my taste, and sometimes it felt like an echo chamber of opinion (as someone who agreed with the opinions discussed it was a bit redundant). Overall, super informative and fun

The majority of the time we just had discussions in class, and if you just talk and add to the discussion you will definitely be fine. She assigns a TON of readings but you don't need to thoroughly read the majority of them, just skim and you will be fine. The class is echo chambery too - if you want discourse this isn't the class for you.
Grading too harsh for an intro-level course, instructions of papers are long and confusing.
Absolutely loved her!

Margot is very passionate about Women's Studies, but I don't think the intro class is the best for her to teach. Most of our work was graded and reviewed by the TA, not her. It was also a little scattered with topics and most lectures turned into random class discussions that somewhat related to what we were learning. Very interesting, and easy A.

Margot was a lot of fun as a professor. She's very sweet and understands you have a life outside of class. There is a lot of reading but a lot of it can be skimmed. The classes are very discussion based and you participation is a percentage of your grade. Essay and discussion heavy. The TA usually grades.
Margot is an amazing professor! Her lectures are very discussion based and she genuinely respects all her students. I wish I could take more classes with her.

Very unclear and difficult grading criteria with all assignments graded by the TA. Lectures were sometimes meandering and focused too much on discussion. It's expected that you agree with what she says.
Very great professor, Dr. Emad is passionate about his lectures and insures his students receive the help they need if asked. Would take again.

Like most COE coding classes, it was easy if you already know some coding, and probably horrible if you didn't. Very passionate about his lectures but they can still get a bit dry at times. Exams were quite easy and the labs are pretty easy as well (and the reports are a joke). Plus all lab stuff can be split with a partner.

Prof. Emad is really caring. He puts learning first instead of giving too much homework, which is one of the best things about him. If all teachers used his approach, the COE would be a lot better, and students would learn more without just struggling to finish homework. He's simply the best.

Professor Emad is highly regarded for his teaching abilities. His lectures are so well-structured and engaging that it's difficult not to grasp the subject matter. He is, without a doubt, among the best in his field.

Amazing professor. His in class slides are detailed and easy to learn from. He goes over many examples to ensure students understand the concepts. Midterms and homework are both VERY fair. He is also just a great guy and cares about his students.
Nice professor with detailed slides. Even though the attendance is mandatory, he is still a good professor. Homework is resonable and useful.
Easy exams, easy homework. Class participation is quizzes in Poll everywhere that no matter if it is right or wrong.

I thought he taught the course well. It's clear he's passionate about the subject, and knows a lot about it. The grading is generous in my experience and I wouldn't hesitate to take one of his classes again in the future.

I don't understand all the hate for Emad. Had him for embedded, and I thought his lectures were interesting, and that he really broke everything down logically to make it easy to understand for the students. Visited office hours with him a few times, it is evident that he cares a lot about his students and gets excited when we are learning!
Good as far as EECE professors go

Spends 2 hours lecturing and often does multiple chapters in one day, there is practically no practice material and what little there is will not help you for tests. Lectures are boring and it is incredibly hard to know what is important and what is filler. Does not prepare students for exams and is then confused when the class average is a 50.
